item.title: Refactor order status to OrderStatus enum
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate as requested. Add src/status.rs defining pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement as_str(self) -> &'static str using lowercase names and Display with the same output. Implement FromStr<Err = ParseStatusError>, where ParseStatusError is public, implements std::error::Error, and its message names the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to with exactly pending -> paid/cancelled and paid -> shipped/cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at crate root; replace all status literals/usages so those lowercase status strings occur only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output/order, and parsing. Run cargo test and commit the work. Acceptance: implementation satisfies the above, cargo test passes, and the change is committed on the item branch. Do not push or merge.

stages.summary:
Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal for the next stage: add public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } with string/display/parsing and transition APIs; change Order::status to the enum; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError; eliminate lowercase status literals outside src/status.rs. Preserve current lifecycle, errors, report order/output, and parsing. No contract exceptions are explicitly allowed.

Original baseline: cbabe9dc7f4e7bea8688a3743d2c700e83b551f9 (HEAD matched; git diff cbabe9...HEAD empty). Characterization commit: 77302415d688e690d314546811a29eb7c6869ed5. Worktree is clean on archon/9fw5mz63-refactor-order-status-to-orderstatus-enu. Last checked tree: c9218061c0d044078b2bf0d83d4ac2bcae1835d9.

Checks: before changes, `export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mengsig/.local/share/archon-bench/full-165-Q4J35ZNK/r-p5gy6w9p/archon-bench/work/20261125T004922Z/f81a1b0188efeea6bd0f6171/.archon/data/cache/refactor-order-status/items/qi_01M889N0MNF53979YT9FW5MZ63/cargo-target; cargo test` passed (3 integration tests). After adding tests, the same command passed (5 integration tests). An initial new test run failed because its fixture incorrectly assumed whitespace was trimmed per field; corrected it to reflect observed whole-line trim and preserved customer whitespace, then reran successfully. Cargo.toml defines a standalone Rust 2021 crate; no README, Makefile, CI config, or additional lint/format/type-check commands were present in the checkout, so no other checks were identified.

Public surface inventory: crate root exports Order and public modules billing, order, report, shipping. Order has public id/customer/total_cents/status fields, new, is_open, cancel. billing exposes pay/outstanding_cents; shipping exposes ship/ready_to_ship; report exposes status_counts, to_line, from_line. Status is a public String today. Observable contracts include transition rejection messages embedding order id/current lowercase status, CSV-like four-field parsing with outer line trim, field count/id/total/status validation errors, comma-separated serialization, BTreeMap alphabetical report order, and input-order IDs from ready_to_ship. No CLI or wire interface beyond report line format.

Added characterization in tests/orders.rs for cancellation from Paid; repeat cancel and pay/ship on Cancelled; cancel after Shipped; exact failure messages; report field-count/id/total/status errors; case-sensitive statuses; whole-line trim with untrimmed customer field; and excess fields. Existing tests already pin the normal lifecycle, ship rejection while Pending, cancellation rejection while Shipped, report count ordering, totals, ready-to-ship order, output, and round trip. Remaining coverage gaps for the refactorer: every direct status-transition pair is not exhaustively enumerated, and parser tests do not cover numeric overflow or empty fields. No feedback was supplied.
